# See Job Run

> See Job Run is construction management software for independent general contractors and small crews. It puts job scheduling, task assignments, time tracking, job-site photos, documents, subcontractor bid requests, and reports in one app that works on iPhone, iPad, Android, and desktop, in English and Spanish. Plans start at $29/month.

## What it does
- **Jobs & scheduling**: organize every job, schedule crews, and track tasks from one place.
- **Subcontractor bidding (Bid Pro)**: send one bid request, share plans, and invite multiple subcontractors per trade. Each sub fills out the bid form in the app, so the contractor can compare bids side by side, award by trade, and turn the winning bid into a subcontract.
- **Time tracking**: log crew time against jobs.
- **Photos & documents**: capture job-site photos and keep plans and documents with each job.
- **Reports**: see job progress and production at a glance.
- **English & Spanish**: every user picks their language; typed notes, tasks, and updates translate automatically.

## Who it's for
Small and independent general contractors, remodelers, and custom-home builders who run their own crews and subcontractors and want one organized system instead of spreadsheets, group texts, and paper.

## Pricing
- Plans start at **$29/month**.
- **Bid Pro** is a **$19/month** option focused on sending and signing subcontractor bids.
- Free trial available. Subcontractors can receive and respond to bid requests for free.
- No Apple/Google in-app-purchase markup.

## How it compares
Unlike enterprise builder platforms such as Procore or Buildertrend (built for large builders and priced accordingly), See Job Run is built for small and independent contractors — simpler and far less expensive — while still covering scheduling, tasks, time, photos, documents, and subcontractor bidding.
